generated: Generated by `pnpm run generate:package` from system/canonical. Do not edit by hand.

slots.RUNTIME_ROOT: Workspace-relative folder that holds the runtime (bin, lib, assets), its config, the workflow steps and the workspace documentation folder.
slots.SESSIONS_ROOT: Folder that holds the session store and the runtime cache; inside the repository (ignored by git) or outside it, as the developer chooses at Bootstrap.
slots.USER_RUNTIME_ROOT: Per-user folder for user-level documentation templates shared across repositories.
slots.REPO_NAME: Display name of the target repository.
slots.AGENT_ROOT: Folder where the client discovers the generated role contracts.
slots.SKILL_ROOT: Folder where the client discovers the generated skills.
slots.KNOWLEDGE_ROOT: Folder that holds the project knowledge documents and their catalogue.
slots.CONTEXT_GLOSSARY_PATH: Path of the repository vocabulary glossary.
slots.VALIDATION_COMMANDS: The repository's build and test commands that validate a change.
slots.LOCAL_MARKDOWN_TRACKER_CONTRACT: Path of the local Markdown tracker contract, when the repository uses local work items.

session-list.summary: List the session ids under the sessions root.

session-activate.summary: Create or resume a session folder; the id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,100}$.

session-memory-read.summary: Return the session memory followed by the list of session artifacts.

session-memory-append.summary: Append one entry to the session memory.

session-event-log.summary: Append one event to the session log.

session-artifact-write.summary: Create or overwrite a named session artifact with its front matter.

session-artifact-list.summary: List the session artifacts with their front matter.

session-image-attach.summary: Copy a local image or download an image URL into the session as an artifact with front matter.

session-execution-report-read.summary: Return the session execution report entries.

visual-evidence.summary: Look at an image from a local path or URL with the model's own vision.
visual-evidence.fallback: Ask the developer for a readable image; never describe an image from its URL or name alone.

workflow-types-list.summary: List the workflow types the developer can choose.

workflow-job-activate.summary: Create or resume a job for a workflow type in a session, optionally on an existing design.

workflow-step-pending.summary: Serve Instruction 1 of the job's workflow.

workflow-step-next.summary: Serve the next instruction of the job's workflow with the active user instruction register appended.

design-obligations.summary: Add, read, update or delete obligations (O#) and their elements (O#.k).

design-open-points.summary: Add, read, update or delete open points (OP#).

design-overview.summary: Write the overview prose (currentState, gaps); gaps must anchor every element as {{O#.k}}.

design-file-references.summary: Add, read, update or delete file references (FR#) per symbol.

design-decisions.summary: Add, read, update or delete decisions (D#) and their options (D#.n).

design-knowledge-references.summary: Add, read, update or delete knowledge references (kid) — one prescription as a knowledge file id and an inclusive line range.

design-submit.summary: Add, patch or delete contracts (CT#), APIs (API#), files (FS#) and operations (IM#) in one call.

design-schema.summary: Return the JSON schema of the design-submit payload.

design-checks.summary: Return the mechanical findings (errors, warnings) and the coverage of the design.

design-snapshot.summary: Return the compact markdown projection of the whole design.

design-verification-view.summary: Return the per-obligation projection the design verifier judges.

design-implementation-context.summary: Return the implementor's projection of the design — contracts, filesystem, decisions and file references, never an operation.

design-implementation-operation.summary: Serve the single operation to implement now, with its knowledge references expanded, or the batch terminator (batch-complete, complete).

design-implementation-operation-close.summary: Close the served operation as Implemented, which makes the next operation reachable.

design-document.summary: Render the review document and return its path as `Design document (<status>): <path>`.

design-approve.summary: Record the developer's approval; refused while any check error remains.

design-operation-status.summary: Set the implementation status of operations (all-or-nothing).

design-iteration-open.summary: Open an implementation iteration and snapshot the workspace.

design-iteration-close.summary: Close an iteration; the file list is the delta from the opening snapshot.

knowledge-catalog.summary: Return the tiered knowledge catalogue (MustHave, PerContext, PerComponent) with file ids.

knowledge-read.summary: Return the content of one or more knowledge documents by file id.

knowledge-create.summary: Create a knowledge document and add it to the catalogue.

knowledge-update.summary: Replace the content of an existing knowledge document.

knowledge-index-rebuild.summary: Rebuild the knowledge catalogue from the knowledge documents.

codebase-clusters.summary: Decompose the workspace files of one extension into named clusters with their sizes.

codebase-cluster-files.summary: Return the full paths of the files in one cluster.

documentation-templates-list.summary: List the documentation templates of the user and workspace folders (workspace wins).

documentation-check.summary: Return placeholder coverage, residual directives and the verdict Ok / Warnings / Errors.

delegate.summary: Start a delegate role in a fresh context with only its prompt, receive its report, and resume it by delegate id.
delegate.fallback: Without resume, start a new delegate of the same role with the complete correction prompt, as the workflow steps state.

work-item-retrieval.summary: Read one work item as Markdown (title, description, image URLs, acceptance criteria, related items).
work-item-retrieval.fallback: The local Markdown tracker contract chosen at Bootstrap.

work-item-type-retrieval.summary: Read the type of a work item.
work-item-type-retrieval.fallback: The local Markdown tracker contract chosen at Bootstrap.

work-item-batch-retrieval.summary: Read several work items by id in one call.
work-item-batch-retrieval.fallback: The local Markdown tracker contract chosen at Bootstrap.

work-item-comment-retrieval.summary: Read the comments of a work item.
work-item-comment-retrieval.fallback: The local Markdown tracker contract chosen at Bootstrap.

work-item-create.summary: Create a bug or user story in the approved tracker.
work-item-create.fallback: The local Markdown tracker contract chosen at Bootstrap; otherwise blocked.

work-item-update.summary: Update approved fields of an existing work item.
work-item-update.fallback: The local Markdown tracker contract chosen at Bootstrap; otherwise blocked.

wiki-catalog-read.fallback: Unavailable operations stay unresolved and block the affected workflow.

wiki-page-list.summary: List the pages of a wiki.
wiki-page-list.fallback: Unavailable operations stay unresolved and block the affected workflow.

wiki-page-read.summary: Read one wiki page as Markdown.
wiki-page-read.fallback: Unavailable operations stay unresolved and block the affected workflow.

roles.name: ask
roles.description: Project-specific Q&A agent for the application development workflow

roles.name: code-implementor
roles.description: Generic code implementor subagent. Implements the work unit described in the prompt by creating, modifying and deleting codebase files, following the procedure and the specification the prompt and the served knowledge provide. It writes and runs tests only when the prompt or the served specification asks for tests

roles.name: design-verifier
roles.description: Design coverage verifier: judges whether the design realizes the requirement, per obligation, and returns a short text report.

roles.name: documentation-reviewer
roles.description: Adversarial documentation reviewer subagent. Reads a produced guide and its entry point, finds unclear or ineffective sections, and fixes them in place.

roles.name: implementation-verifier
roles.description: Implementation verifier subagent: judges whether the code produced for a work unit is congruent with its specification, applies the project knowledge and respects the specification it was given. Read-only.

roles.name: knowledge-builder
roles.description: Agent specialized in building knowledges for projects

roles.name: orchestrator
roles.description: Workflow orchestrator agent for the application development workflows

skills.name: author-repo-skill
skills.description: Use when: adding a new repository-local skill, or reworking an existing one, so a repeatable procedure lives in a skill instead of being retyped into prompts or grafted onto a role contract.

skills.name: manage-work-item
skills.description: Use when: the user explicitly invokes this workflow to create a bug or user story, or to update an existing work item, in this repository's tracker.

skills.name: plan-bug-from-id
skills.description: This prompt is used to generate an implementation plan based on a bug work item ID provided by the user.

skills.name: plan-user-story-from-id
skills.description: This prompt is used to generate an implementation plan based on a work item ID provided by the user.

skills.name: user-story-analysis
skills.description: Use when: critically analyzing a user story for functional gaps, ambiguities, inconsistencies, missing requirements, edge cases, risks and implicit assumptions.
